commands.name: verification gate
commands.note: gofmt + vet + tests + schema parity + PSScriptAnalyzer. Run before opening a PR; CI runs the same gate plus cross-compilation.

commands.name: cross build
commands.note: Builds windows/linux/darwin, amd64+arm64. Signing and publish targets are Windows signing-host only.

commands.name: schema parity
commands.note: schema/inventory.schema.json and powershell/inventory.schema.json are the same contract and must stay byte-identical.

commands.name: signed release
commands.note: Public tier = unsigned + PublicTrust-signed; private tier = PrivateTrust. WDAC-enforced fleets also need a supplemental App Control policy.
